name: DominoPilot – AI Content Generator & Auto Poster
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Domino Pilot empowers your WordPress workflow by integrating with powerful AI models (via OpenAI-compatible APIs like LongCat AI, OpenAI, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter). Generate high-quality, SEO-friendly blog posts or comprehensive keyword clusters in minutes.

Key Features:

  • Universal API Support: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
  • Bulk Generator: Transform a list of keywords into separate blog posts automatically.
  • Keyword Clustering: Create a single “Pillar Page” from a main topic and sub-topics.
  • Secure: Your API key is stored securely in your database.
  • Customizable: Choose your model, target word count, and post status.

Service Disclosure:

This plugin relies on third-party AI services to generate content. By default, it is configured to work with OpenAI-compatible APIs.
* Service Used: The plugin sends the prompts you enter (keywords and topics) to the API endpoint you configure in the settings (e.g., OpenAI, LongCat AI, OpenRouter).
* Data Sharing: Your keywords and prompt instructions are sent to the external API provider for processing.
* Terms of Use: Please refer to the specific Terms of Service and Privacy Policy of the API provider you choose to use.
* OpenAI Privacy Policy
* LongCat AI Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the domino-pilot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Domino Pilot” menu to configure your API settings.
  4. Enter your API URL and API Key.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you must provide a valid API key for the service you intend to use (e.g., OpenAI, LongCat AI).

Does this plugin work with ChatGPT?

Yes, if you use the OpenAI API endpoint and a valid API key.

content generated is safe?

The generated content is sanitized before being saved to your site to ensure safety, but you should always review AI-generated content for accuracy and tone.
